note: modes = world modes in which the creature exists (modes.json). behaviour: passive (ignores the player), flee, watch (seals: can only be watched), thief (steals from drying racks), territorial (warns, then attacks inside aggro_m), night_hunter (attacks at night, fears fire), fog (spawns only where fog density > fog_min), guardian (boss). Damage and hp are balanced for a player with 100 hp at the start and food buffs on top (docs/03_BALANCE.md §5).

creatures.special: casts a false beacon light that lures the boat onto rocks

creatures.appears: moves into the home once a stove and a bed stand there and comfort is 5+
creatures.boon: +2 comfort while fed (one gift every 3 days); now and then tidies a chest

creatures.rule: do not steam after midnight: the third steam is his
creatures.boon: Steam buff lasts 50% longer while the rule is kept

creatures.appears: big forested islands, only in dense fog
creatures.boon: leave a gift on a stump and a green wisp leads you to the path or the shore for 60 s; in Saga, walking his forest at night without a gift makes him lead you astray (no harm, just lost time)

creatures.appears: rivers and lakes of the Summer Shore and the Ter Coast
creatures.boon: give him the first catch of the day: +30% bites until the day ends

creatures.appears: at dawn on the high rocks of the Ter Coast and the Frozen Sea
creatures.boon: hearing her song adds its motif to the music of the sea and a page to the journal

creatures.appears: surfaces in the Frozen Sea on calm nights; an island with a tiny chapel on its back
creatures.boon: land on its back: rest by the chapel (Rested +10 min) and a unique journal page; it dives again at dawn and returns you to your boat

creatures.appears: never seen: the old people who went under the earth; their mines and stone circles hold stories and finds
creatures.boon: ruins with journal pages, mica and old iron; a respectful legend, never enemies

creatures.appears: an optional cave on the Summer Shore
creatures.special: sleeps until you are close; blind on the side of its missing eye: sneak past or strike from that side
breath of frost dims lanterns and the torch; fire is its weakness
gusts push the player off ledges; ice needles; phase 2 at 50% hp calls a squall
drags the player into the mire; summons kikimoras; burns away with torches
rises from the sea at the shore rocks; tidal waves; can be fought from the koch or from the rocks

name.en: Mga, the Heart of the Fog

creatures.special: the fog itself: swallows lights, splits into mistlings, weak while every lantern around the arena burns
